analysis_method.metric: sum of normalized counts on the circuit's ideal Z-basis support
analysis_method.comparison_baseline: uniform distribution over all measured bit strings

interpretation: The deterministic mapping probe reaches 99/100 and is consistent with the archived q-to-c permutation. Because its prepared qubit state is the palindrome 101, this job alone cannot distinguish the two opposite overall provider-key directions.

The formal Bell and GHZ-3 results remain well above their uniform-support baselines, and their ideal states are the dominant observed peaks, but leakage is material and is reported without mitigation.
The installed SpinQ SDK states that triangulum_vp does not support a customized physical layout, so pair remapping was not available as a documented optimization for these jobs.
No job was rerun or selected to improve the reported support rate. S-260811-0003 was recovered by a read-only query after local normalization failed.
A Z-basis distribution alone does not certify entanglement or coherence; these measurements are hardware-execution evidence and consistency checks only.
